known_limits: NOT REVIEWED. No Israeli labour lawyer and no payroll officer has read this against the agreements. 457 passing assertions mean the encoding agrees with itself.

NO GOLDENS YET. The VINYL brief forbade blessing goldens while own-line-below-a-field was unruled, because 100 of the arms' @nlg:he heralds sit on record fields. That ruling is now made — l4-ide #435, merged 2026-09-21: inside a field list an annotation on its own line describes the field ABOVE it — so the reason has expired. What remains before blessing: a binary that carries #435 (l4-vinyl and l4-mistletoe both predate it) and a read of the rendered heralds against the Hebrew before any output is enshrined.
HERALD PLACEMENT: 42 own-line, 180 trailing (parsed from the AST). Own-line heralds under a GIVEN/GIVETH were captured backward on this binary and render only after l4-ide #433.

ONE 2016 SHEKEL-SUPPLEMENT SCHEDULE, NO PERIOD INPUT. he-brutto carries only the חוזר תשפ"ו/6 figures (from 1.1.2026) and reads them for every pay month, so a 2023–2025 payslip is overstated by the 2024→2026 step of that supplement: on OCTOPUS C01 (rank 4, September 2024) this encoding pays 11,859.94 where A, F and F2, which carry the January circulars by year, pay 11,811.98 — a difference of 47.96, which is exactly 851.91 − 803.95, the rank-4 figure of the 2026 circular less the 2024 one. Arm A″ shares the defect. Found by OCTOPUS, not by any of the 457 assertions.
